BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning search warrants for toxicological analysis of blood samples.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to search warrants for toxicological analysis of blood samples; and adding a new section to chapter 10.79 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 10.79 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: When issuing a search warrant to draw a sample of a person's blood and conduct toxicological analysis, a magistrate may not limit the scope of the toxicological analysis or otherwise prohibit general toxicological screening if probable cause exists to indicate impairment arising from alcohol or any drug.
